title: A Promise Fulfilled
content:
The laughter inside the room had barely faded...

When the door slowly opened once again.

Standing at the entrance...

Was Yashwanth's father.

The moment Yashwanth saw him...

His eyes immediately became moist.

Without thinking for even a second...

He walked toward his father like a little child.

Holding his father's hand tightly, he smiled through his tears.

"Thank you, Dad..."

"Thank you so much..."

"For understanding me."

His father smiled gently and placed a comforting hand on Yashwanth's head.

"You are my son."

"Why wouldn't I understand you?"

"As your father..."

"Your happiness will always matter more than anything else."

Unable to hold back his emotions any longer...

Yashwanth hugged his father tightly.

His father embraced him with the same warmth.

After a few moments, he looked toward Siddu.

"There is only one problem left."

"My friend..."

"The one whose daughter I promised to my son..."

"What should I tell him now?"

Siddu smiled confidently.

"Leave that to me, Uncle."

"I'll handle everything."

Yashwanth and his father exchanged curious glances.

Siddu took out his phone and dialled a number.

After a few rings...

The call was answered.

"Hello?"

Siddu smiled politely.

"Good afternoon."

"This is Siddhartha speaking."

For a brief moment...

There was complete silence.

Then, suddenly...

The man's voice became filled with excitement.

"S-Siddhartha...?"

"From France?"

"Sir... is it really you?"

"I've been trying to get an appointment with you for months."

"I never imagined I'd receive a call from you."

Siddu smiled.

"I know you've been trying to meet me."

"I was planning to arrange a meeting soon."

"But before that..."

"I need a small favour."

Without any hesitation, the man replied,

"Of course, sir."

"Please tell me."

"If it's within my capacity..."

"I'll definitely do it."

Siddu briefly explained the entire situation.

He spoke about Yashwanth...

Varsha...

And the misunderstanding surrounding the arranged marriage.

After listening patiently...

The man smiled.

"I understand everything now."

"Don't worry, sir."

"I'll take care of it."

"Please don't trouble yourself anymore."

A smile appeared on Siddu's face.

"Thank you."

After ending the call, he turned toward Yashwanth and his father.

"The problem has been solved."

Relief immediately spread across both their faces.

Yashwanth's father smiled proudly.

"Then there's nothing left to worry about."

He looked affectionately at his son.

"Go."

"Call all your friends."

"My son's wedding should be celebrated with everyone he loves."

Yashwanth's eyes sparkled with happiness.

He looked at Siddu.

Then at his father.

The two people who had stood beside him when he needed them the most...

Asking for nothing in return.

Unable to express his gratitude through words...

He simply smiled.

A smile filled with peace.

A smile he had waited a long time to wear.

Soon...

The house that had once been burdened by uncertainty came alive with wedding preparations.

Laughter echoed through every room.

Smiles replaced worry.

The beginning of a new chapter had finally arrived.

________________________________________

Meanwhile...

Thousands of kilometers away...

In the beautiful city of Paris...

Shreya and Yagnesh were enjoying lunch at one of the city's most famous restaurants, renowned for its romantic atmosphere.

Soft music floated gently through the air.

Elegant lights reflected across the beautifully decorated dining hall.

Couples around them quietly enjoyed each other's company.

Shreya happily savoured her favourite dish, a bright smile decorating her face.

Sitting opposite her...

Yagnesh wasn't paying much attention to the food.

Instead...

His eyes remained fixed on her.

After a few moments, Shreya noticed him staring.

She raised an eyebrow playfully.

"What happened?"

Yagnesh smiled softly and shook his head.

"Nothing."

He paused for a moment before continuing.

"I was just wondering..."

"How someone as lucky as me managed to meet someone like you."

A faint blush spread across Shreya's cheeks.

She lowered her eyes with a shy smile.

"You've started saying such sweet things now?"

Yagnesh laughed softly.

"Only because they're true."

Before Shreya could respond...

Her phone vibrated on the table.

The cheerful atmosphere paused for a moment.

She glanced at the screen.

The smile on her face slowly changed.

Without wasting another second...

She answered the call.
